headline: Bottom Malaga visit Alaves, who have not won in five
summary: Malaga arrive in Vitoria bottom of La Liga: beaten 5-2 at home by Real Sociedad on Sunday, with 4 points and no win this season. Alaves have problems of their own — five La Liga games without a victory. Even so, home advantage makes Alaves 54.9% favourites, with the handicap line set at three-quarters of a goal in their favour. Malaga give up 1.94 expected goals a game, and Cadena SER reports that midfielder Munoz is out with a muscle injury. The goal line is 2.25, with over at 53.1%. A narrow home win is the likeliest result.
read: Malaga arrive bottom of La Liga, winless in nine and beaten 5-2 at home by Real Sociedad last weekend, with Joaquin Munoz reported out and J. Cruz a doubt. Alaves are 54.9% favourites at home despite their own five-game winless run, rated about three-quarters of a goal the better side with the total leaning slightly over 2.25 goals.

facts.fact: Malaga were beaten 5-2 at home by Real Sociedad on October 18.
facts.meaning: The bottom side arrive after their heaviest defeat of the season, three days before this trip to Vitoria.

facts.fact: Malaga are bottom of La Liga with 4 points from 9 games and no win.
facts.meaning: They come to Mendizorroza as the clear underdogs, with four draws and five defeats so far.

facts.fact: Alaves have gone five La Liga games without a win, losing four of them.
facts.meaning: The favourites are not in form themselves — their last victory came in mid-September.

facts.fact: Alaves are 54.9% favourites to win at home.
facts.meaning: More likely than not to take the three points, but nowhere near a formality.

facts.fact: The main handicap line is Alaves -0.75.
facts.meaning: Alaves are rated about three-quarters of a goal the better side — the market expects a narrow win rather than a rout.

facts.fact: Malaga have conceded 1.94 xG per game across their last five matches.
facts.meaning: They give up real chances every week, so Alaves should get the openings to win this even in average form.

facts.fact: The goal line is 2.25, with over priced at 53.1%.
facts.meaning: The market leans slightly toward two goals or more — more likely than not, but only just.

facts.fact: Alaves' -0.75 handicap has firmed from 46.9% to 48.8% fair since Sunday.
facts.meaning: Support for the home side's handicap has grown in recent days, not just for the outright win.

sources.fact: Alaves lost 2-1 away to Celta Vigo in La Liga, a result that lifted Celta to eighth in the table.
Alaves are due to face Barcelona at home in La Liga on October 31.
Alaves players not selected for other squads could be called up by the Basque Country national team for their November friendly at San Mames.
Cadena SER reports that Malaga's Joaquin Munoz has a right soleus muscle injury and is expected to miss Friday's La Liga clash against Alaves.
Malaga were beaten 5-2 at home by Real Sociedad in La Liga on October 18.
Takefusa Kubo scored a goal and added an assist against Malaga on his first start since September.
The match is La Liga's tenth round fixture, with Malaga visiting Vitoria to face Alaves at Mendizorroza.
